text:
Strategy: Keep leftovers at least half usable. A leftover of at least half this item can fit a future smaller item, while one just below half is nearly dead space. Score bins by leftover with a bonus at half the item size, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin keeping a half-usable leftover. Exact fits tie at the top. It may help by saving half-usable space, but may fail by overvaluing leftovers that later items never fit.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item / 2 if r - item >= item / 2 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Half-usable bonus: +item/2 when post-placement leftover >= item/2.
